## Documentation Files

  A themeable, better-looking checkbox for WinForms, inspired by iCheck, with per-state color control.
- [KimTools / Controls / CheckButton](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-check-button/)
  A themeable multi-select toggle control for WinForms, with independent Checked/Unchecked styling for background, border and icon.
- [KimTools / Controls / Date](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-date/)
  A modern, highly customizable Date Picker control for WinForms supporting custom icons, border radius, theme color styling, and alignment modes.
- [KimTools / Controls / Divider](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-divider/)
  A visual separator control for Modern WinForms providing styled divider lines, customizable orientations, dash caps, and gradient edge fading.
- [KimTools / Controls / Label](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-label/)
  A theme-aware label control for Modern WinForms with intelligent foreground contrast generation and KtColor palette integration.
- [KimTools / Controls / Menu](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-menu/)
  An expandable tree-style navigation menu supporting independently themeable state styles, gradient highlights, custom connector lines, checkboxes, and inline badge tags.
- [KimTools / Controls / Pages](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-pages/)
  An invisible tab-based navigation container for Modern WinForms that provides SPA-style routing, custom page transitions, navigation history, and design-time extenders.
- [KimTools / Controls / Panel](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-panel/)
  A modern, fully customizable panel control for WinForms. It is a container for grouping and styling related content.
- [KimTools / Controls / PictureBox](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-picture-box/)
  A modern, customizable PictureBox control supporting rounded corners, custom border styles, image filters, and dynamic gradient/brush masking.
- [KimTools / Controls / ProgressRadial](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-progress-radial/)
  A customizable circular progress indicator with gradient arcs, independent cap styles, sub/superscript annotations, and smooth animation support.
- [KimTools / Controls / Progress](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-progress/)
  A stylish progress indicator supporting dual-layer rendering, gradient fills, hatch patterns, rounded corners, per-edge border control, and animated spinner text.
- [KimTools / Controls / RadioBox](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-radio-box/)
  A customizable, stylish radio button control for WinForms with built-in binding and color states.
- [KimTools / Controls / RadioButton](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-radio-button/)
  A themeable single-select control for WinForms, with independent checked and unchecked styling for background, border, icon and foreground.
- [KimTools / Controls / Rating](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-rating/)
  A customizable rating input with star, circle, and square shapes, independent color states for empty, hover, rated, and disabled, plus read-only and right-click-to-clear support.
- [KimTools / Controls / Select](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-select/)
  A fully owner-drawn dropdown with rounded corners, theme-aware colors, adjustable indicator styles, and independent styling for the closed surface and dropdown list items.
- [KimTools / Controls / Shapes](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-shapes/)
  A versatile shape renderer supporting circles, ovals, squares, rectangles, polygons, and lines with independent fill, border, rotation, and side-count control.
- [KimTools / Controls / Switch](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-switch/)
  A smooth, highly customizable toggle switch control for Modern WinForms supporting custom state styling and animations.
- [KimTools / Controls / Table](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-table/)
  A fully themed data grid with per-region skinning, rounded cell corners, custom scrollbar overlays, and native-looking checkbox, button, and link rendering.
- [KimTools / Controls / TextBox](https://kimtoo.net/controls/kt-text-box/)
  An enhanced, highly flexible text input control for Modern WinForms supporting custom styles, SVG icons, and automatic casing.
